task: Create a new Word document named 'paragraph_summary.docx'. Read the content from 'random_paragraph.txt', write a three-sentence summary of its content into the Word document, and ensure the summary covers the setting, main character, and atmosphere described in the paragraph.
query_sentence: Summarize the content of the specified text file into a new Word document.

Write this summary to 'paragraph_summary.docx', not back to the .txt or any other file.
